InsPolicyBillingInfo.name: InsPolicyBillingInfo
InsPolicyBillingInfo.description: Stores information related to billing and supports billing workflows and integration with downstream financial systems.

BillDayOfMonth.description: The day of the month when invoice generation starts for installment billing if a customer chooses to pay in installments (1-31).

BillStartMonth.description: The month when billing begins for recurring billing schedules (1–12, where 1 = January).

BillToContactId.description: The contact related to the insurance policy bill.

BillingTreatmentId.description: The rules that determine how an insurance policy is billed. For example, advance or arrears.

InsurancePolicyId.description: The insurance policy associated with the insurance policy billing item.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

LegalEntityId.description: The legal entity associated with the insurance policy billing information.

PaymentTermId.description: Specifies the timing and conditions for payments and bill settlements for an insurance policy.

ProductSellingModelId.description: Indicates whether the insurance policy is sold as a one-time or an installment-based sale.

ProrationPolicyId.description: Specifies how charges and refunds are adjusted during billing events such as, mid-cycle changes, cancellations, and upgrades.

TaxTreatmentId.description: Specifies how taxes are calculated, applied, and reported for billing transactions.
